name: Persistent motion
summary: Keep every hold alive with running markers, highlight sweeps, pulsing meters, blinking cursors, bouncing dots and marching dashes.
qualityBar: Marker sits on each node exactly at each leg end; route A-B-C-B-A repeats every 4 legs; eases in and out (inOutCubic midpoint exact)
Arrival ring fires on arrival and decays within 0.45 s; none on nodes not reached
Sweep: never more than two items bright, steps through every item, loops each 2.4 s period
Meters: seeded, within 0..1, real range over 0.3, never level with each other
Cursor has on and off phases, loops; typing dots hop 0.18 period apart
Six primitives change more than 20 pixels between frames 0.2 s apart at three start times (real canvas pixel tests)
Demo 8 s 1080x1920 silent: layout built by 1.2 s then four seconds of hold, QC reports no frozen run
verifiedBy: 2026-11-19: node test.mjs exit 0 at full size 1080x1920 (45 checks passed, 0 failed; demo 8 s, silent; engine QC on the card and on the mp4 passed with 1 warning(s), motion floor 0.009710679216149412). I viewed out/contact.png (12 frames, thumbnails) and judged it good: marker, sweep, meters, dots, cursor all visibly in different states across the hold. NOT checked: motion judged from stills, pixel-diff tests and motion-energy numbers, not played back by a person; lineRunner (dot down a dimension line) and arrivalRing are unit-tested but only drawNodes' ring path is used in the demo; the window's lower right is sparse.
